title: Invention Judges
intro: Dreamed up something that should exist? Type it in. Three judges score it out of ten, tell you why, and then the panel gives its verdict.
submission: an invention they have made up: what it is, what it does, and who it is for
placeholder: A backpack that weighs itself and...
tip: Say what it does and who it is for. The judges want to picture it.

judges.name: The Engineer
judges.character: Practical and unexcitable. Cares whether the thing could actually be built.

rubric.9: realistic, and names the parts it would need
rubric.5: plausible but vague about how it works
rubric.2: needs something that does not exist

judges.name: The Investor
judges.character: Impatient. Cares whether anybody actually needs this.

rubric.9: names a real problem and the people who have it
rubric.5: useful to somebody, but unclear who
rubric.2: solves nothing anyone was worried about

judges.name: The Ten Year Old
judges.character: Honest to a fault. Cares whether it is cool.

rubric.2: bored before the end of the sentence
